targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='done' AND updated_at - created_at <= interval '24 hours') / greatest(count(*), 1) AS completion_pct FROM tasks WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days'

panels.title: p95 inter-agent latency (publish -> claim; SLA < 10 min)

targets.rawSql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM t.updated_at - o.published_at)) AS p95_seconds FROM tasks t JOIN outbox o ON o.msg_id = t.task_id::text WHERE t.status IN ('claimed','done') AND o.published_at IS NOT NULL AND t.created_at > now() - interval '7 days'
SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE first_pass_green) / greatest(count(*) FILTER (WHERE first_pass_green IS NOT NULL), 1) AS green_pct FROM tasks WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days'
SELECT date_trunc('hour', updated_at) AS time, avg(attempt) AS avg_attempts, max(attempt) AS max_attempts FROM tasks WHERE updated_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tokens per merged PR (Headroom pre/post, via OTel)
panels.description: Populated from agent/tracing.py OTLP export (gen_ai.usage.*, headroom.tokens_pre/post). Target: -15-20% tokens per merged PR.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', updated_at) AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='failed') AS failed FROM tasks WHERE updated_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
